$comment: Harness config. This is the override layer: a plugin's own plugin.json holds its defaults, and entries here win. Set enabled:false to switch a plugin off entirely.
$messageLog: During early access (SHARING_IS_OPTIONAL false in telemetry.mjs) every call to a Rosalena cloud model (GLM, DeepSeek, Rosalena) is sent to the site's database with the app's early-build tracking (telemetry.mjs): the exact prompt and answer, timing, usage and error. With sharing optional, words are sent only after the person chose 'Share chats' (Account > Sharing, asked once on the welcome screen). Local models are never recorded. Nothing is written on this machine unless `local:true` (a developer's offline copy in <ROSALENA_HOME>/logs). `enabled:false` switches it off, and ROSALENA_MESSAGE_LOG=off does the same for one launch.

rosa-local-model-host.$comment: This machine only (the release build ships a neutral config, so testers keep plugin.json's 16384). 2026-10-29: Rosalena loaded qwen3.8-27b at 16384 on the shared :8080, DSH took it as already loaded, and a 68k DSH session could neither answer nor compact. Load at the same 131072 window and q8_0 KV cache as D:\llama.cpp\start-qwen.ps1, which is what fits it on the 3090.

rosa-comfyui.$comment: The local renderer on :8188. Nothing here starts it: one GPU holds one big model, and whatever owns the card (ContentFarm's gpu-switch.ps1) decides when the writer is unloaded. The presets point at ContentFarm's API-format graphs on this machine because those name model files that actually exist here - copy a JSON anywhere and change `workflow` if you move them. comfy_generate fills the placeholders: {{prompt}} and {{negative}} from the tool call, everything else from `params` (an exact placeholder keeps its JSON type, so {{steps}} stays a number).
